blocks.text:
Base + Watery veggies + Moderate Carbs + Simple Protein source + Crunchy/Nutty + Acidic + sauce/dressing

The idea is to pick one or more ingredient(s) for each of above category and you always end up with good and new salad.
These are smartly designed to complement each other and also form a contrasting flavor profile.
 
Many videos in this section with follow this idea and/or help with individual section ideas


Roughly estimate following this blue print is 400-600 calories with 25-35 grams of protein and heavy fibre/micro nutient sources. 
Check each section for more info
blocks.title: Principle

blocks.text:
Leafy veggies that creates the base of salad. These form the volume to it.
Give the psychological effect of eating a big volume of food whilst the total calories account to 10-15 cal. 

Don't over do it. I prefer a handful quantity is good enough. 

Examples:
Romaine lettuce
Baby spinach
Shredded green/purple cabbage 
Massaged kale
Mixed field greens / spring mix Shredded iceberg lettuce
Arugula (rocket)
Chopped flat-leaf parsley.
blocks.title: BASE

blocks.text:
Hydrating and crunchy bite producing. 
Prefer small cut 2 varaities atleast and have them dices to similar sizes.

These are again low in cal, highly nutritional and crunchy/water filled bites.  

Examples:
Diced Cucumber
Grated or shredded Carrot
Sweet Corn
Sliced or grated radishes 
Red/yellow/green bell peppers
Thinly sliced celery
Raw zucchini half-moons
Sliced snap peas
blocks.title: WATERY/CRUNCHY VEGGIES

blocks.text:
Moderate Direct protein source.

Ideally this will be the only thing that might need to be cooked while you construct the rest of salad.

Crumbled, cubed, pan fried, air fired.

Target for 15-25 grams protein quantity worth from these soruces

Examples:
Cubed or crumbled firm tofu
Cubed or crumbled low-fat paneer Chopped/crushed hard-boiled eggs
Shrimp
tempeh
chicken etc


I also like to add little but if sauce when cooking these. Can skip the sauce/dressing section if added here. 

for example: crumbled tofu + 1 tsp teriyaki sauce.
blocks.title: PROTEIN SOURCE

blocks.text:
These form the starchy Beans/legumes/pulses/grains providing steady, complex carbohydrate energy, partial protein & Fibre source
.
Based on the size, we can soak overnight and use directly, or pressure cook a little.

Simple formula: 100grams raw of any beans/legumes seem to have roughly 20-25 grams protein(350ih calories). I suggest half serving(50 grams raw) of anything.


Examples:
Sprouts
Chickpeas
Edemamae kidney beans
green moong beans
Black beans
Black-eyed peas
Brown or green lentils 
Whole green chana 

can also be,(but no protein thought)
steamed sweet potato cubes
quinoa, rice etc.
blocks.title: CARB SOURCE

blocks.text:
The crispy & crunchy parts. with all the watery stuff , this adds the nutty part and makes the salad feel solid. 

while these usually add healthy fats, be careful not to add too much volume. very calorie intense foods. 
1-2 tbps at best.

Examples:
Roasted peanuts 
Pumpkin seeds (pepitas), Watermelon seeds
Sunflower seeds 
Toasted sliced almonds 
Crushed walnuts
Toasted sesame seeds 
Pine nuts 
Hemp hearts.
blocks.title: CRUNCHY/NUTTY

blocks.text:
Useful for a Sharp, bright elements that cut through the richness.I strongly recommend this contrast to feel the freshness if veggies. 

Examples:
Fresh lemon/lime juice,
Fresh lime juice
Apple cider vinegar
Rice vinegar
Pickled red onions
Green olives
Pickled jalapeños
Blsamic vinegar
blocks.title: ACIDIC

blocks.text:
Some wet ingrident to bind all these together. Be creative here. exact same salad recipe with a change dressing can feel like a while new recipe. 

Ideally always keep one spicy source, creamy source & tangy/acidic source at home. play with them. YT has 100s of recipes with yogurt based 

Examples:
Cilantro-Sriracha emulsion
Creamy garlic yogurt sauce Cilantro-lime
Mint chutney
Ttahini-garlic dressing 
Greek yogurt ranch
Lemon-herb vinaigrette
Hummus thinned with lemon juice.
blocks.title: DRESSING/SAUCE

blocks.text:
Optional but very refreshing. Few drops make the end product feel like some complicated chef curated dish.

Examples:
Feta cheese crumbles
Cotija or parmesan cheese shavings
Finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes
Small drizzle of crispy chili oil
Few drops of toasted sesame oil
Anchovy paste
Miso paste
Roasted garlic cloves.
blocks.title: Bonus: UMAMI (optional)
